description: This file provides database utility functions for managing a PostgreSQL connection pool and executing SQL queries asynchronously using the 'anyio' library. It includes internal functions to ensure the connection pool is initialized, execute synchronous queries, and exposes asynchronous functions for database operations.

classes.name: ConnectionPool
classes.description: A connection pool for PostgreSQL connections, managing multiple connections for efficient database access.

methods.name: _ensure_pool()
methods.description: Initializes the global connection pool if not already initialized, using database connection settings.

methods.name: _sync_query(sql: str, params: Optional[Iterable[Any]] = None, fetch_one: bool = False)
methods.description: Executes a SQL query synchronously, fetching either one row or all rows.

methods.name: int _sync_execute(sql: str, params: Optional[Iterable[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Executes a SQL command that modifies data (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) synchronously.

methods.name: db_query(sql: str, params: Optional[Iterable[Any]] = None, fetch_one: bool = False)
methods.description: Asynchronous function to perform a SQL query and return dict row(s).

methods.name: int db_execute(sql: str, params: Optional[Iterable[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Asynchronous function to execute a SQL command that modifies data.

ctags.name: _sync_query
ctags.pattern: /^def _sync_query(sql: str, params: Optional[Iterable[Any]] = None, fetch_one: bool = False):$/
ctags.signature: (sql: str, params: Optional[Iterable[Any]] = None, fetch_one: bool = False)

ctags.name: db_execute
ctags.pattern: /^async def db_execute(sql: str, params: Optional[Iterable[Any]] = None) -> int:$/

ctags.name: db_query
ctags.pattern: /^async def db_query(sql: str, params: Optional[Iterable[Any]] = None, fetch_one: bool = False):$/
ctags.signature: (sql: str, params: Optional[Iterable[Any]] = None, fetch_one: bool = False)
